_forward_notes.distribution_frequency: Quarterly only for AW9U (First REIT). All other five REITs are semi-annual payers. D5IU is nominally semi-annual but distributions are currently SUSPENDED.
_forward_notes.forecast_dpu: Only UIBU has a true forward DPU forecast (IPO prospectus Profit Projection): PY2027 6.8 cents (FY ending 31 Mar 2027). D5IU = 0.0 (distributions affirmatively suspended). M1GU, AW9U, BMGU, XZL = null (no quantified forward DPU guidance disclosed by managers).
_forward_notes.rental_reversion: Disclosed only for M1GU (+12.0%, 1Q 2026) and D5IU (-0.8%, 1Q 2026). N/A for AW9U (master-leased healthcare) and XZL (hotel, no leases). Not disclosed as a % for BMGU. UIBU null (newly listed, no realised reversion; one example lease +20.0% and forward below-market upside noted).
_forward_notes.pct_debt_due_12m: Cleanly derivable for AW9U (~2.8%), D5IU (0% - all loans mature 2034), BMGU (~5.3% from FY2025 current-borrowings note). Null for UIBU (only Consumption Tax facilities fall in FY2026, repaid on tax refund - not normal-course), M1GU (undimensioned bar chart only) and XZL (short 1.2yr WADM but no maturity ladder disclosed).
_forward_notes.dpu_change_per_100bps: MAS-mandated +100bps DPU sensitivity is NOT disclosed by any of the six REITs. M1GU, BMGU and XZL disclose the related MAS +100bps ICR sensitivity instead (captured in notes). UIBU discloses a +/-50bps distribution-YIELD sensitivity (PY2027 -0.2pp at +50bps), not the MAS DPU format.
_forward_notes.dpu_yoy: Full-year FY2025-vs-FY2024 DPU YoY derivable for M1GU (+23.4%), AW9U (-8.1%), BMGU (-38.3%) and XZL (-46.7%). UIBU null (no prior year - IPO). D5IU null/not-meaningful (DPU 0 in both periods).
_forward_notes.caveats: (1) UIBU forecast DPU is a prospectus Profit Projection (PY2027), not actual results; subject to listed assumptions. (2) BMGU pct_debt_due_12m is as at the 31 Dec 2025 balance-sheet date (FY2025 results note 6); the 28 May 2026 1Q update did not restate the current/non-current split. (3) XZL pct_debt_due_12m left null despite the very short 1.2-year WADM because no exact maturity-ladder figure is disclosed - do not infer. (4) AW9U DPU YoY shown on full-year basis (-8.1%); latest single-quarter trend was -13.8% YoY. (5) All ICR sensitivities recorded in notes are NOT DPU sensitivities and must not be substituted for dpu_change_per_100bps_pct.
